component.name: Pyrasite GUI
component.summary: A tool for interacting with running Python processes

description.p: A graphical interface for Pyrasite that lets you monitor, analyze, introspect, and alter running Python programs.

On startup Pyrasite GUI presents the running Python processes it can find on the system. It can graph process activity, display stack traces, show object memory summaries, and produce call graphs without modifying the target program.
